# Fig Performance

> Private one-on-one personal training gym in Placentia, California, for adults over 40 who want to lose fat, build muscle and get stronger. Coached by Daniel Figueroa ("Coach Dan"), an ACSM certified personal trainer and Precision Nutrition Level 1 certified nutrition coach. Progress is measured with InBody body-composition scans, and members get red light and vibration therapy for recovery.

- Address: 1284 E. Yorba Linda Blvd, Placentia, CA 92870
- Phone: (714) 396-7178
- Email: trainat@figperformance.com
- Staffed hours: Monday to Friday 5 AM to 8 PM, Saturday 5 AM to 12 PM, closed Sunday. Personal training is by appointment.
- Serves: Placentia, Yorba Linda, Brea, Fullerton, Anaheim Hills and Villa Park (Orange County, CA)
- Reviews: 75 reviews of Coach Dan in total: 5.0 on Google (25 reviews of Fig Performance), 5.0 on Yelp (38 reviews of Train With Dan, his coaching business) and 12 more five-star reviews from people Dan coached before opening Fig Performance
- Price: personal training is $90 a session, 3-month minimum, 20% off when paid in full for 3 months. Online coaching is $249 a month as a 3-month program ($697 paid in full). The first consult is free. Book it online: https://calendly.com/trainwithcoachdan/free-consult-inbody-scan

- [Online personal trainer (online coaching)](https://www.figperformance.com/online-personal-trainer): weekly 1:1 video call with Coach Dan, custom training in the app, custom 80/20 nutrition, supplement guidance; $249/month, 3-month program
- [In-home personal training](https://www.figperformance.com/in-home-personal-training): Coach Dan trains you one-on-one in your own home gym across North Orange County and nearby cities
- [InBody scan in Placentia](https://www.figperformance.com/inbody-scan-placentia): body-composition testing (body fat, muscle, visceral fat), free with a consult
- [Red light therapy in Placentia](https://www.figperformance.com/red-light-therapy-placentia): recovery service included with membership; cost, safety, near Fullerton and Yorba Linda
- [Vibration therapy in Placentia](https://www.figperformance.com/vibration-therapy-placentia): whole-body vibration included with membership; does it work, who should skip it

- [Personal training in Placentia](https://www.figperformance.com/personal-training-placentia): how one-on-one training works, client results, pricing, hours
- [Personal training cost in Placentia](https://www.figperformance.com/personal-training-cost-placentia): 2026 prices, what changes the price, how to compare trainers
- [Nutrition coaching in Placentia](https://www.figperformance.com/nutrition-coaching-placentia): included with personal training; more protein, set calories, a simple plan from foods you like, no obsessive tracking
- [Free consult + InBody scan](https://www.figperformance.com/free-consult-placentia): free, about an hour, no commitment

## Guides for adults over 40

- [Fitness after 40](https://www.figperformance.com/fitness-after-40): index of all guides
- [Simple meal plan for weight loss + grocery list (free PDF)](https://www.figperformance.com/meal-plan-for-weight-loss): protein, carbs, fats and fiber at every meal; palm of protein, fist of vegetables, high-fiber carbs; breakfast, lunch, dinner and snack options; free PDF at https://www.figperformance.com/assets/fig-performance-meal-plan.pdf
- [How to lose 10 pounds in a month](https://www.figperformance.com/how-to-lose-10-pounds-in-a-month): realistic with about a 1,000-calorie daily deficit (500 food, 500 movement), high protein and strength training; about 8 lb fat plus water; client Adriana, 48, lost 10 lb in her first month
- [GLP-1s and muscle loss](https://www.figperformance.com/glp-1-muscle-loss): how to keep muscle on semaglutide or tirzepatide: protein at least goal weight in grams, lifting 2-3x a week, enough calories, daily walking, and habits for after stopping
- [Strength training for women over 50](https://www.figperformance.com/strength-training-for-women-over-50): age doesn't decide the program, the assessment does; menopause, bone density (LIFTMOR), protein; clients Teresa (60) and Sam (70)
- [Workout plan for men over 40](https://www.figperformance.com/workout-plan-for-men-over-40): train for function, start light, fix neck, shoulders, back, hips and knees; client Jonathan, 43, went from back pain to a 185 lb bench
- [Tib raises](https://www.figperformance.com/tib-raises): why the tibialis anterior matters for shock absorption, knees and shin splints; wall tib raises, kettlebell toe raises, tib bar; 5-30 reps
- [3-day workout split for beginners](https://www.figperformance.com/3-day-beginner-workout-plan): why full body 3 days a week works, and links to the women's and men's plans
- [Beginner workout plan for women](https://www.figperformance.com/beginner-workout-plan-for-women): Coach Dan's 3-day full-body plan: 4 leg and glute exercises (squat or lunge, hinge, hip thrust, abduction last), 2 upper body, 1 core (2 sets) a day, rest 1:15-2 min, warm-up, exercise guide with easier and at-home versions
- [Beginner workout plan for men](https://www.figperformance.com/beginner-workout-plan-for-men): Coach Dan's 3-day split: 2 leg exercises and 1 calf exercise first each day, chest/back/shoulders on days 1 and 3, arm day in the middle, wall tib raises, 2 core sets, rest 1:15-2 min
- [How to avoid holiday weight gain after 40](https://www.figperformance.com/how-to-avoid-holiday-weight-gain): Coach Dan's rules: protein first, room for dessert (he eats 80/20), train on Thanksgiving, set drink boundaries, keep each holiday to a few days, plus a hotel workout
- [How to lose weight after 40](https://www.figperformance.com/how-to-lose-weight-after-40): Coach Dan's plan for busy professionals: daily steps, protein, lifting heavy enough, training twice a week, hormones, and body recomposition
- [Can you build muscle after 60?](https://www.figperformance.com/build-muscle-after-60): yes, with two client examples (Teresa, 60, first pull-up in about 3 months; Sam, 70, deadlifting 135 lb for reps) and the exact progression used
- [Why am I not losing weight?](https://www.figperformance.com/why-am-i-not-losing-weight): Coach Dan says you're almost always not in a true calorie deficit; nine reasons (portions, protein at 0.7-1 g per lb, progressive overload, daily steps, sleep, stress, measuring, medical) and what to do about each
- [Strength training for women over 40](https://www.figperformance.com/strength-training-for-women-over-40): how often to lift, what to do, how heavy, and a sample week
